Exam Date & Time: 30-Jan-2023 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
 THIRD SEMESTER B.TECH. (COMPUTER SCIENCE & ENGINEERING) EXAMINATIONS -  
  JAN/FEB 2023  
  SUBJECT : CSE 2154 - OBJECT ORIENTED PROGRAMMING  
  (MAKEUP)  
  OBJECT ORIENTED PROGRAMMING [CSE 2154]  
Marks: 50                                                                             Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
1A)          What are varargs? Illustrate varargs and the ambiguity associated with them with an  
  example program.                                                                        (3)  
  
1B)          Write two different Java programs to illustrate the following:  
  i) Using labelled break as a Form of goto.                                                  (3)  
  ii) Labelled break inside nested loops.  
  
1C)          Create a Date class with three integer instance variables named day, month, year. It has  
  a constructor with three parameters for initializing the instance variables, and it has one  
  method named daysSinceJan1( ). Override toString() method for Date class to be used  
  to display date in the format dd/mm/yyyy. It computes and returns the number of days  
  since January 1 of the same year, including January 1 and the day in the Date object. For  
  example, if day is a Date object with day = 1, month = 3, and year = 2000, then the         (4)  
  call date.daysSinceJan1( ) should return 61 since there are 61 days between the dates  
  of January 1, 2000, and March 1, 2000, including January 1 and March 1. Include a  
  DateDemo class that tests the Date class by creating an array of Date class of size n.  
  Don't forget leap years.  
  
2A)          Create a generic class with one type parameter, T. Provide an appropriate constructor  
  that initialises the data member of this class that holds a reference to an array of type T.  
  Also, implement the following methods:  
  1) getDevice(int id) that returns a Device object whose id is passed in method argument.  
  If no record is found, it displays an appropriate message and returns the first device.  
  2) sort() that sorts the records of Device based on watt where, class Device contains  
  two data members watt and id. Create two classes Fan and Kettle that are derived from  
  Device. sweep (short) and brand (String) are data members of Fan. Also, Kettle  
  contains two data members capacity (double) and name (String). Provide a method              (5)  
  display() in both the classes to print the details on the console output. Write a driver  
  class that  
  i) creates an array of Fan and Kettle devices.  
  ii) Instantiate the generic class on Fan and Kettle devices and display them.  
  iii) Invoke the getDevie(int id) method on both the instances and display the device  
  details.  
  iv) Use the instances to sort the records by calling the sort() method.  
  
2B)          Demonstrate the use of bounded wildcard arguments.  
  (3)  
  
2C)          Demonstrate with an example how the CERT rule to validate return values of a method  
  is beneficial.                                                                              (2)

3A)   Create a Book class with private instance variables for Book ID, Title, Author, and Price.  
  Add appropriate accessor methods for these variables. Then create a subclass Novel with  
  instances variables for the Category and Publisher. Also, include appropriate  
  constructors for your classes. Create a class with main() method to instantiate an array (5)  
  of FIVE Novels. Initialize the array during creation and display all the Novel's Titles  
  published by 'Pearson' Publishers.  
  
3B)   Create a package testpkg consisting of two classes A and B, class A being public should  
  have three variables, three methods (each variable and method of different access  
  specifier: default, public and protected) and a member interface consisting of two  
  methods. Class B being default should have a single method. Name this program as        (3)  
  A.java.  
  Write a Java program to compile and execute the package testpkg using imports.  
  
3C)   Consider the following code. Is it written correctly? If so, mention output of the  
  program, else, list the error/errors in the program.  
  
  
  (2)  
  
  
4A)   "Synchronized threads communication, is termed as inter-thread communication" Justify  
  your Answer with proper code snippets how do Threads communicate.                     (2)  
  
4B)   Write a Java Program to Sort an Array of Integers (Read from user randomly) in the  
  Ascending order and Descending Order simultaneously. Analyse your program with            (3)  
  proper Input.  
  
4C)   Create a javafx application select Insurance Policy and pay the premium as shown in the  
  given Figure. Write the complete program with import statements and Analyse the  
  program with proper inputs?  
  
  
  (5)  
  
  
5A)   Demonstrate with a suitable example how to use a Toggle Button and Check box in  
  JavaFx and Analyse your code with proper inputs?                                          (4)

5B)             What is Dynamic method dispatch? Demonstrate with a suitable example how java  
  implements run-time polymorphism.                                               (3)  
  
5C)             What are Packages? Analyse hierarchy of packages with suitable example?  
  (3)  
  
-----End-----
